objects.description: Describes a single vertex attribute stream: base pointer, attribute byte size, and stride between consecutive elements. Used with multi-stream APIs for remapping and shadow index generation.
Controls exponent sharing strategy for meshopt_encodeFilterExp when compressing floating-point data.
Result structure for vertex cache analysis: counts and quality metrics (ACMR/ATVR). Returned by meshopt_analyzeVertexCache.
Result structure for vertex fetch cache analysis. Returned by meshopt_analyzeVertexFetch.
Result structure for overdraw analysis using software rasterization. Returned by meshopt_analyzeOverdraw.
Result structure for coverage analysis per axis, with extent. Returned by meshopt_analyzeCoverage.
Describes a meshlet: ranges and counts into externally stored micro-index (triangles) and vertex-indirection arrays.
Bounding data for clusters/meshlets: sphere and normal cone in float, and a packed int8 SNORM version. Returned by compute*Bounds.
Internal stack-like temporary allocator used by C++ wrappers to manage intermediate index buffers. Owns a small LIFO list of allocated blocks and uses configurable global Storage callbacks.
Nested type of meshopt_Allocator that holds function pointers for allocation and deallocation callbacks.

functions.name: meshopt_generateVertexRemap
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_generateVertexRemap(unsigned int* destination, const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, const void* vertices, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_size);
functions.description: Builds a remap table mapping old vertex indices to a compacted set of unique vertices by deduplicating binary-equal vertices. Use the remap with meshopt_remapVertexBuffer/meshopt_remapIndexBuffer to reorder buffers.
requirements: destination must have space for vertex_count elements
indices may be NULL for unindexed input
All vertex_size bytes (including padding) participate in equality; padding should be zero-initialized
stride is not used; vertices is a tightly packed array using vertex_size

functions.name: meshopt_generateVertexRemapMulti
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_generateVertexRemapMulti(unsigned int* destination, const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, size_t vertex_count, const struct meshopt_Stream* streams, size_t stream_count);
functions.description: Builds a remap table from multiple vertex streams, deduplicating vertices that are binary-equal across the provided streams. Use the resulting remap to reorder each vertex stream and the index buffer.
requirements: destination must have space for vertex_count elements
indices may be NULL for unindexed input
stream_count must be <= 16
Each meshopt_Stream must have stride >= size; equality uses all size bytes (zero-initialize padding)

functions.name: meshopt_generateVertexRemapCustom
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_generateVertexRemapCustom(unsigned int* destination, const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, const float* vertex_positions, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_positions_stride, int (*callback)(void*, unsigned int, unsigned int), void* context);
functions.description: Builds a remap table using a custom equivalence: vertices are first matched by identical positions, then (optionally) by user-provided equality callback. Use the remap to reorder vertex/index buffers.
requirements: destination must have space for vertex_count elements
indices may be NULL for unindexed input
vertex_positions must have float3 position in the first 12 bytes of each vertex; vertex_positions_stride specifies stride
callback may be NULL (only position equality used) or must return 1 if vertices (by index) are equivalent and 0 otherwise

functions.name: meshopt_remapVertexBuffer
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API void meshopt_remapVertexBuffer(void* destination, const void* vertices, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_size, const unsigned int* remap);
functions.description: Reorders (and compacts) a vertex buffer according to a remap table produced by meshopt_generateVertexRemap*.
requirements: destination must have space for unique_vertex_count elements (as returned by meshopt_generateVertexRemap), each of size vertex_size
vertex_count is the original input vertex count (not the unique count)
remap must contain vertex_count elements mapping old -> new indices

functions.name: meshopt_remapIndexBuffer
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API void meshopt_remapIndexBuffer(unsigned int* destination, const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, const unsigned int* remap);
functions.description: Rewrites indices to reference the remapped vertex order based on a remap table produced by meshopt_generateVertexRemap*.
requirements: destination must have space for index_count elements
indices may be NULL for unindexed input
remap must be the remap of vertices (old -> new) with length equal to vertex_count used by indices

functions.name: meshopt_generateShadowIndexBuffer
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API void meshopt_generateShadowIndexBuffer(unsigned int* destination, const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, const void* vertices, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_size, size_t vertex_stride);
functions.description: Produces an index buffer for attribute-subset rendering (e.g., depth-only) by mapping binary-equivalent vertices (w.r.t. the first vertex_size bytes) to the first occurrence.
requirements: destination must have space for index_count elements
All vertex_size bytes participate in equivalence; padding should be zero-initialized
vertex_stride controls spacing between elements; must be >= vertex_size

functions.name: meshopt_generateShadowIndexBufferMulti
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API void meshopt_generateShadowIndexBufferMulti(unsigned int* destination, const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, size_t vertex_count, const struct meshopt_Stream* streams, size_t stream_count);
functions.description: Produces an index buffer for attribute-subset rendering using multiple streams; vertices binary-equal across specified streams map to the first occurrence.
requirements: destination must have space for index_count elements
stream_count must be <= 16
Each meshopt_Stream must have stride >= size; equality uses all size bytes (zero-initialize padding)

functions.name: meshopt_generatePositionRemap
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API void meshopt_generatePositionRemap(unsigned int* destination, const float* vertex_positions, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_positions_stride);
functions.description: Builds a remap table mapping vertices with the same position to the same existing index. Useful for positional-only processing.
requirements: destination must have space for vertex_count elements
vertex_positions must have float3 position in the first 12 bytes; stride provided by vertex_positions_stride

functions.name: meshopt_generateAdjacencyIndexBuffer
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API void meshopt_generateAdjacencyIndexBuffer(unsigned int* destination, const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, const float* vertex_positions, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_positions_stride);
functions.description: Creates an index buffer for triangle adjacency topology, expanding each triangle to 6 indices: original vertices interleaved with adjacent vertices for each edge.
requirements: destination must have space for index_count*2 elements
vertex_positions must have float3 position in the first 12 bytes; stride provided by vertex_positions_stride

functions.name: meshopt_generateTessellationIndexBuffer
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API void meshopt_generateTessellationIndexBuffer(unsigned int* destination, const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, const float* vertex_positions, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_positions_stride);
functions.description: Creates an index buffer for PN-AEN tessellation with crack-free displacement by expanding each triangle to a 12-index patch with prescribed layout.
requirements: destination must have space for index_count*4 elements
vertex_positions must have float3 position in the first 12 bytes; stride provided by vertex_positions_stride

functions.name: meshopt_generateProvokingIndexBuffer
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_generateProvokingIndexBuffer(unsigned int* destination, unsigned int* reorder, const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, size_t vertex_count);
functions.description: Produces an index buffer where each triangle’s provoking vertex index equals the primitive id, returning the size of the reorder table used to fetch original vertices in the vertex shader.
requirements: destination must have space for index_count elements
reorder must have space for worst-case vertex_count + index_count/3 elements
For maximum efficiency, input indices should be optimized for vertex cache first

functions.name: meshopt_optimizeVertexCache
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API void meshopt_optimizeVertexCache(unsigned int* destination, const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, size_t vertex_count);
functions.description: Reorders indices to reduce GPU vertex shader invocations for typical post-transform caches.
requirements: destination must have space for index_count elements
If the index buffer contains multiple ranges for multiple draw calls, call this per range

functions.name: meshopt_optimizeVertexCacheStrip
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API void meshopt_optimizeVertexCacheStrip(unsigned int* destination, const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, size_t vertex_count);
functions.description: Reorders indices favoring strip-like locality and compression; generally inferior for GPU cache vs meshopt_optimizeVertexCache but better for strips/compression.
requirements: destination must have space for index_count elements

functions.name: meshopt_optimizeVertexCacheFifo
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API void meshopt_optimizeVertexCacheFifo(unsigned int* destination, const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, size_t vertex_count, unsigned int cache_size);
functions.description: Reorders indices for a FIFO-style vertex cache, trading off some quality for faster optimization.
requirements: destination must have space for index_count elements
cache_size should be less than the actual GPU cache size to avoid thrashing
If multiple draw ranges exist, optimize each range individually

functions.name: meshopt_optimizeOverdraw
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API void meshopt_optimizeOverdraw(unsigned int* destination, const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, const float* vertex_positions, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_positions_stride, float threshold);
functions.description: Reorders indices (starting from a vertex-cache-optimized order) to reduce overdraw while keeping vertex transform count within a threshold of the optimal.
requirements: destination must have space for index_count elements
indices must be the result of meshopt_optimizeVertexCache (not original order)
vertex_positions must have float3 position in the first 12 bytes; stride provided by vertex_positions_stride
threshold controls allowed vertex cache efficiency degradation; e.g. 1.05 allows up to 5% worse

functions.name: meshopt_optimizeVertexFetch
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_optimizeVertexFetch(void* destination, unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, const void* vertices, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_size);
functions.description: Reorders vertices and updates indices to minimize vertex fetch bandwidth. Returns the number of unique vertices (may be less than input if unused vertices are removed).
requirements: destination must have space for vertex_count elements (of size vertex_size)
indices is both input and output
Function is for a single vertex stream; for multiple streams use meshopt_optimizeVertexFetchRemap + meshopt_remapVertexBuffer

functions.name: meshopt_optimizeVertexFetchRemap
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_optimizeVertexFetchRemap(unsigned int* destination, const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, size_t vertex_count);
functions.description: Generates a vertex remap that minimizes vertex fetch bandwidth when applied to vertices/indices. Returns the number of unique vertices.
requirements: destination must have space for vertex_count elements
Use the returned remap with meshopt_remapVertexBuffer/meshopt_remapIndexBuffer

functions.name: meshopt_encodeIndexBuffer
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_encodeIndexBuffer(unsigned char* buffer, size_t buffer_size, const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count);
functions.description: Encodes a triangle list index buffer into a compact byte stream for better size and compressibility. Returns encoded size on success, 0 if buffer_size is insufficient.
requirements: buffer must have enough space; compute worst-case via meshopt_encodeIndexBufferBound
Input must represent a triangle list
For best results, pre-optimize with vertex cache/fetch optimizers

functions.name: meshopt_encodeIndexBufferBound
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_encodeIndexBufferBound(size_t index_count, size_t vertex_count);
functions.description: Computes worst-case encoded size bound (in bytes) for meshopt_encodeIndexBuffer.
requirements: index_count and vertex_count must reflect the buffer to be encoded; no additional constraints stated

functions.name: meshopt_encodeIndexVersion
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API void meshopt_encodeIndexVersion(int version);
functions.description: Sets the index encoder format version to use for subsequent encodes.
requirements: version must be 0 (decodable by all versions) or 1 (decodable by library 0.14+)

functions.name: meshopt_decodeIndexBuffer
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API int meshopt_decodeIndexBuffer(void* destination, size_t index_count, size_t index_size, const unsigned char* buffer, size_t buffer_size);
functions.description: Decodes an index buffer previously encoded by meshopt_encodeIndexBuffer. Returns 0 on success, non-zero error code on failure. Safe for untrusted input though output may contain invalid indices.
requirements: destination must have space for index_count elements of size index_size
index_size must match the intended output element size (2 or 4 typical)
buffer/buffer_size must point to the encoded data

functions.name: meshopt_decodeIndexVersion
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API int meshopt_decodeIndexVersion(const unsigned char* buffer, size_t buffer_size);
functions.description: Returns the encoded index buffer/sequence format version, or -1 if the header is invalid. A non-negative value doesn’t guarantee correct decode on malformed input.
requirements: buffer/buffer_size must point to encoded data produced by meshopt_encodeIndexBuffer/Sequence

functions.name: meshopt_encodeIndexSequence
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_encodeIndexSequence(unsigned char* buffer, size_t buffer_size, const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count);
functions.description: Encodes a general index sequence to a compact byte stream. For triangle lists, meshopt_encodeIndexBuffer is usually better. Returns encoded size or 0 if buffer_size is insufficient.
requirements: buffer must have enough space; compute worst case via meshopt_encodeIndexSequenceBound

functions.name: meshopt_encodeIndexSequenceBound
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_encodeIndexSequenceBound(size_t index_count, size_t vertex_count);
functions.description: Computes worst-case encoded size bound (in bytes) for meshopt_encodeIndexSequence.

functions.name: meshopt_decodeIndexSequence
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API int meshopt_decodeIndexSequence(void* destination, size_t index_count, size_t index_size, const unsigned char* buffer, size_t buffer_size);
functions.description: Decodes an index sequence encoded by meshopt_encodeIndexSequence. Returns 0 on success, non-zero error code on failure. Safe for untrusted input though output may contain invalid indices.
requirements: destination must have space for index_count elements of size index_size

functions.name: meshopt_encodeVertexBuffer
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_encodeVertexBuffer(unsigned char* buffer, size_t buffer_size, const void* vertices, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_size);
functions.description: Encodes a single-stream vertex buffer into a compact format. Returns encoded size on success, 0 if buffer_size is insufficient.
requirements: buffer must have enough space; compute worst case via meshopt_encodeVertexBufferBound
vertex_size must be a multiple of 4 and <= 256
All vertex_size bytes are encoded verbatim (zero-initialize padding)

functions.name: meshopt_encodeVertexBufferBound
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_encodeVertexBufferBound(size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_size);
functions.description: Computes worst-case encoded size bound (in bytes) for meshopt_encodeVertexBuffer.
requirements: vertex_size constraint is not enforced here but should match encoder requirements (multiple of 4, <= 256)

functions.name: meshopt_encodeVertexBufferLevel
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_encodeVertexBufferLevel(unsigned char* buffer, size_t buffer_size, const void* vertices, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_size, int level, int version);
functions.description: Encodes a vertex buffer like meshopt_encodeVertexBuffer, allowing selection of compression level and (optionally) explicit format version.
requirements: buffer must have enough space; compute worst case via meshopt_encodeVertexBufferBound
vertex_size must be a multiple of 4 and <= 256
level should be in [0,3]: higher is slower and compresses better
version should be -1 (use global), or 0/1; level only takes effect with version 1

functions.name: meshopt_encodeVertexVersion
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API void meshopt_encodeVertexVersion(int version);
functions.description: Sets the vertex encoder format version to use for subsequent vertex encodes.
requirements: version must be 0 (decodable by all versions) or 1 (decodable by library 0.23+)

functions.name: meshopt_decodeVertexBuffer
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API int meshopt_decodeVertexBuffer(void* destination, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_size, const unsigned char* buffer, size_t buffer_size);
functions.description: Decodes a vertex buffer previously encoded by meshopt_encodeVertexBuffer. Returns 0 on success, non-zero error code otherwise. Safe for untrusted input though output may be garbage.
requirements: destination must have space for vertex_count * vertex_size bytes
vertex_size must be a multiple of 4 and <= 256

functions.name: meshopt_decodeVertexVersion
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API int meshopt_decodeVertexVersion(const unsigned char* buffer, size_t buffer_size);
functions.description: Returns the encoded vertex buffer format version, or -1 if the header is invalid. A non-negative value doesn’t guarantee successful decode for malformed input.
requirements: buffer/buffer_size must point to encoded vertex data

functions.name: meshopt_decodeFilterOct
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API void meshopt_decodeFilterOct(void* buffer, size_t count, size_t stride);
functions.description: In-place decodes octahedral unit-vector encoding (K-bit signed X/Y; Z must store 1.0f) produced by the corresponding encode filter.
requirements: Each element must be 4 or 8 bytes (stride == 4 or 8) with components stored as 8-bit or 16-bit normalized integers
count specifies number of vectors; operates in place on buffer

functions.name: meshopt_decodeFilterQuat
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API void meshopt_decodeFilterQuat(void* buffer, size_t count, size_t stride);
functions.description: In-place decodes 3-component quaternion encoding (K-bit component encoding + 2-bit component index) produced by the corresponding encode filter.
requirements: stride must be 8 bytes
Components stored as 16-bit integers; operates in place on buffer

functions.name: meshopt_decodeFilterExp
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API void meshopt_decodeFilterExp(void* buffer, size_t count, size_t stride);
functions.description: In-place decodes exponential floating-point encoding with 8-bit exponent and 24-bit integer mantissa (2^E*M).
requirements: stride must be divisible by 4
Each 32-bit component is decoded independently; operates in place on buffer

functions.name: meshopt_decodeFilterColor
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API void meshopt_decodeFilterColor(void* buffer, size_t count, size_t stride);
functions.description: In-place decodes colors encoded in YCoCg(+A) produced by the corresponding encode filter.
requirements: stride must be 4 or 8 bytes
Components stored as 8-bit or 16-bit normalized integers; operates in place on buffer

functions.name: meshopt_encodeFilterOct
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API void meshopt_encodeFilterOct(void* destination, size_t count, size_t stride, int bits, const float* data);
functions.description: Encodes unit vectors into octahedral representation with K-bit signed X/Y; Z set to 1.0f; W preserved.
requirements: stride must be 4 or 8 bytes
bits must be in [2,16] (implied by comment)
data must contain count*4 floats (x,y,z,w)
destination must have space for count elements at given stride

functions.name: meshopt_encodeFilterQuat
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API void meshopt_encodeFilterQuat(void* destination, size_t count, size_t stride, int bits, const float* data);
functions.description: Encodes unit quaternions with K-bit component encoding + 2-bit index of the largest component to reconstruct.
requirements: stride must be 8 bytes
bits must be in [4,16] (implied by comment)
data must contain count*4 floats (x,y,z,w)

functions.name: meshopt_encodeFilterExp
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API void meshopt_encodeFilterExp(void* destination, size_t count, size_t stride, int bits, const float* data, enum meshopt_EncodeExpMode mode);
functions.description: Encodes floating-point data using 8-bit exponent and K-bit integer mantissa into an exponential form. Exponent can be per-component, per-vector, shared, or clamped by mode.
requirements: stride must be divisible by 4
bits must be in [1,24] (implied by comment)
data must contain count*(stride/4) floats
mode selects exponent sharing/clamping strategy

functions.name: meshopt_encodeFilterColor
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API void meshopt_encodeFilterColor(void* destination, size_t count, size_t stride, int bits, const float* data);
functions.description: Encodes RGBA colors by converting RGB to YCoCg and quantizing components with K bits (A uses K-1).
requirements: stride must be 4 or 8 bytes
bits must be in [2,16] (implied by comment)
data must contain count*4 floats

functions.name: meshopt_simplify
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_simplify(unsigned int* destination, const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, const float* vertex_positions, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_positions_stride, size_t target_index_count, float target_error, unsigned int options, float* result_error);
functions.description: Reduces triangle count while attempting to preserve appearance and topology; stops early if topology constraints or target error prevent hitting the target. Returns new index count and writes new indices to destination.
requirements: destination must have space for up to index_count elements (worst case)
vertex_positions must have float3 position in the first 12 bytes; stride provided by vertex_positions_stride
target_error is relative to mesh extents in [0..1] (unless meshopt_SimplifyErrorAbsolute is used)
options is a bitmask of meshopt_SimplifyX flags (0 is safe)
result_error may be NULL; if not NULL receives resulting relative error

functions.name: meshopt_simplifyWithAttributes
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_simplifyWithAttributes(unsigned int* destination, const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, const float* vertex_positions, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_positions_stride, const float* vertex_attributes, size_t vertex_attributes_stride, const float* attribute_weights, size_t attribute_count, const unsigned char* vertex_lock, size_t target_index_count, float target_error, unsigned int options, float* result_error);
functions.description: Simplifies while incorporating attribute differences into the error metric; can lock vertices and reports resulting error. Returns new index count and writes new indices.
requirements: destination must have space for up to index_count elements (worst case)
vertex_positions must have float3 position in the first 12 bytes; stride given
vertex_attributes must have attribute_count floats per vertex at vertex_attributes_stride
attribute_weights must have attribute_count floats; attribute_count <= 32
vertex_lock may be NULL or must provide one value per vertex (1 means cannot be moved)
target_error is relative to mesh extents in [0..1]
options is a bitmask of meshopt_SimplifyX flags
result_error may be NULL

functions.name: meshopt_simplifyWithUpdate
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_simplifyWithUpdate(unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, float* vertex_positions, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_positions_stride, float* vertex_attributes, size_t vertex_attributes_stride, const float* attribute_weights, size_t attribute_count, const unsigned char* vertex_lock, size_t target_index_count, float target_error, unsigned int options, float* result_error);
functions.description: Simplifies with destructive updates to positions/attributes for better appearance; writes new indices in-place and updates vertex data in-place. Returns new index count.
requirements: vertex_positions must have float3 position in the first 12 bytes; stride given
vertex_attributes must have attribute_count floats per vertex; attributes with zero weight are not updated
attribute_weights must have attribute_count floats; attribute_count <= 32
vertex_lock may be NULL or must have one value per vertex (1 means cannot be moved)
target_error is relative to mesh extents in [0..1]
options is a bitmask of meshopt_SimplifyX flags
result_error may be NULL

functions.name: meshopt_simplifySloppy
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_simplifySloppy(unsigned int* destination, const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, const float* vertex_positions, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_positions_stride, const unsigned char* vertex_lock, size_t target_index_count, float target_error, float* result_error);
functions.description: Fast, topology-relaxing simplifier that prioritizes performance over visual fidelity. Returns new index count and writes new indices.
requirements: destination must have space for up to index_count elements (worst case)
vertex_positions must have float3 position in the first 12 bytes; stride given
vertex_lock may be NULL; if used, must be consistent (1 for all indices sharing same position cannot be moved)
target_error is relative to mesh extents in [0..1]
result_error may be NULL

functions.name: meshopt_simplifyPrune
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_simplifyPrune(unsigned int* destination, const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, const float* vertex_positions, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_positions_stride, float target_error);
functions.description: Removes small isolated mesh parts to reduce triangle count. Returns new index count and writes new indices.
requirements: destination must have space for up to index_count elements (worst case)
vertex_positions must have float3 position in the first 12 bytes; stride given
target_error is relative to mesh extents in [0..1]

functions.name: meshopt_simplifyPoints
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_simplifyPoints(unsigned int* destination, const float* vertex_positions, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_positions_stride, const float* vertex_colors, size_t vertex_colors_stride, float color_weight, size_t target_vertex_count);
functions.description: Reduces a point cloud to target count, balancing position and (optional) color differences. Returns new point count and writes a new index order referencing original vertices.
requirements: destination must have space for target_vertex_count elements
vertex_positions must have float3 position in the first 12 bytes; stride given
vertex_colors may be NULL; if not NULL, must have float3 color in first 12 bytes; stride given
color_weight selects weight of color vs position (1.0 is a safe default)

functions.name: meshopt_simplifyScale
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API float meshopt_simplifyScale(const float* vertex_positions, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_positions_stride);
functions.description: Returns the error scaling factor used to convert between absolute and relative errors for simplification.
requirements: vertex_positions must have float3 position in the first 12 bytes; stride given
Absolute target_error must be divided by this scale before passing to simplify; multiply result_error by this to get absolute error

functions.name: meshopt_stripify
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_stripify(unsigned int* destination, const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, size_t vertex_count, unsigned int restart_index);
functions.description: Converts a (cache-optimized) triangle list to a triangle strip; can use primitive restart or degenerate triangles. Returns the resulting strip index count and writes it.
requirements: destination must have space for worst-case size; compute with meshopt_stripifyBound
For best results, run meshopt_optimizeVertexCache first
restart_index should be 0xffff or 0xffffffff depending on index size, or 0 to use degenerates

functions.name: meshopt_stripifyBound
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_stripifyBound(size_t index_count);
functions.description: Computes worst-case index count bound for meshopt_stripify.

functions.name: meshopt_unstripify
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_unstripify(unsigned int* destination, const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, unsigned int restart_index);
functions.description: Converts a triangle strip (with optional primitive restart) to a triangle list. Returns list index count and writes it.
requirements: destination must have space for worst-case size; compute with meshopt_unstripifyBound
restart_index must match the encoding (0xffff/0xffffffff) if used

functions.name: meshopt_unstripifyBound
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_unstripifyBound(size_t index_count);
functions.description: Computes worst-case index count bound for meshopt_unstripify.

functions.name: meshopt_analyzeVertexCache
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API struct meshopt_VertexCacheStatistics meshopt_analyzeVertexCache(const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, size_t vertex_count, unsigned int cache_size, unsigned int warp_size, unsigned int primgroup_size);
functions.description: Analyzes index order using a simplified FIFO vertex cache model and returns statistics (vertices transformed, warps executed, ACMR, ATVR).
requirements: Parameters should reflect the target hardware model; results may not match actual GPU performance

functions.name: meshopt_analyzeVertexFetch
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API struct meshopt_VertexFetchStatistics meshopt_analyzeVertexFetch(const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_size);
functions.description: Analyzes vertex fetch traffic using a simplified direct-mapped cache model and returns byte counts and overfetch ratio.
requirements: vertex_size should match actual vertex buffer layout used with indices
Results may not match actual GPU performance

functions.name: meshopt_analyzeOverdraw
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API struct meshopt_OverdrawStatistics meshopt_analyzeOverdraw(const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, const float* vertex_positions, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_positions_stride);
functions.description: Estimates overdraw via a software rasterizer and returns coverage and shading statistics; useful for evaluating index order w.r.t. overdraw.
requirements: vertex_positions must have float3 position in the first 12 bytes; stride given
Results may not match actual GPU performance

functions.name: meshopt_analyzeCoverage
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API struct meshopt_CoverageStatistics meshopt_analyzeCoverage(const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, const float* vertex_positions, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_positions_stride);
functions.description: Computes coverage statistics (fraction of viewport covered from each axis) via a software rasterizer and returns extent.
requirements: vertex_positions must have float3 position in the first 12 bytes; stride given

functions.name: meshopt_buildMeshlets
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_buildMeshlets(struct meshopt_Meshlet* meshlets, unsigned int* meshlet_vertices, unsigned char* meshlet_triangles, const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, const float* vertex_positions, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_positions_stride, size_t max_vertices, size_t max_triangles, float cone_weight);
functions.description: Partitions a mesh into meshlets (clusters) with micro-indexing and vertex indirection suitable for mesh shading or clustered renderers. Returns the number of meshlets and fills meshlets/vertex/triangle arrays.
requirements: meshlets must have space for all meshlets; worst-case bound from meshopt_buildMeshletsBound
meshlet_vertices must have space up to index_count elements (worst case), not vertex_count
meshlet_triangles must have space up to index_count elements (worst case)
vertex_positions must have float3 in first 12 bytes; stride given
max_vertices <= 256 and max_triangles <= 512
cone_weight = 0 when cone culling unused; otherwise in [0,1]

functions.name: meshopt_buildMeshletsScan
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_buildMeshletsScan(struct meshopt_Meshlet* meshlets, unsigned int* meshlet_vertices, unsigned char* meshlet_triangles, const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, size_t vertex_count, size_t max_vertices, size_t max_triangles);
functions.description: Builds meshlets via a scan-based method from indices only. Returns the number of meshlets and fills outputs.
requirements: meshlets must have space for all meshlets; worst-case bound from meshopt_buildMeshletsBound
meshlet_vertices must have space up to index_count elements (worst case)
meshlet_triangles must have space up to index_count elements (worst case)
For best efficiency, input indices should be vertex-cache optimized
max_vertices <= 256 and max_triangles <= 512

functions.name: meshopt_buildMeshletsBound
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_buildMeshletsBound(size_t index_count, size_t max_vertices, size_t max_triangles);
functions.description: Computes worst-case number of meshlets (for allocation) for given limits and index_count.

functions.name: meshopt_buildMeshletsFlex
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_buildMeshletsFlex(struct meshopt_Meshlet* meshlets, unsigned int* meshlet_vertices, unsigned char* meshlet_triangles, const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, const float* vertex_positions, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_positions_stride, size_t max_vertices, size_t min_triangles, size_t max_triangles, float cone_weight, float split_factor);
functions.description: Builds meshlets with flexible cluster sizes between min and max triangles, optionally splitting large-bounds clusters based on split_factor. Returns count and fills outputs.
requirements: meshlets/meshlet_vertices/meshlet_triangles must have worst-case space; use meshopt_buildMeshletsBound with min_triangles
vertex_positions must have float3 in first 12 bytes; stride given
max_vertices <= 256, max_triangles <= 512, and min_triangles <= max_triangles
cone_weight as for meshopt_buildMeshlets
split_factor must be non-negative; when >0, may split clusters unless under min_triangles

functions.name: meshopt_buildMeshletsSpatial
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_buildMeshletsSpatial(struct meshopt_Meshlet* meshlets, unsigned int* meshlet_vertices, unsigned char* meshlet_triangles, const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, const float* vertex_positions, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_positions_stride, size_t max_vertices, size_t min_triangles, size_t max_triangles, float fill_weight);
functions.description: Builds meshlets optimized for ray tracing, allowing min/max triangles per meshlet and a fill_weight trade-off between size and SAH quality. Returns count and fills outputs.
requirements: meshlets/meshlet_vertices/meshlet_triangles must have worst-case space; use meshopt_buildMeshletsBound with min_triangles
vertex_positions must have float3 in first 12 bytes; stride given
max_vertices <= 256, max_triangles <= 512, min_triangles <= max_triangles
fill_weight is a tuning parameter; 0.5 is a safe default

functions.name: meshopt_optimizeMeshlet
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API void meshopt_optimizeMeshlet(unsigned int* meshlet_vertices, unsigned char* meshlet_triangles, size_t triangle_count, size_t vertex_count);
functions.description: Reorders a single meshlet’s vertices and micro-triangles to improve locality (rasterization and ray tracing performance).
requirements: meshlet_triangles/meshlet_vertices must reference the meshlet’s data (e.g., via offsets from meshopt_Meshlet)
vertex_count <= 256 and triangle_count <= 512

functions.name: meshopt_computeClusterBounds
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API struct meshopt_Bounds meshopt_computeClusterBounds(const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, const float* vertex_positions, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_positions_stride);
functions.description: Computes bounds (sphere and normal cone) for a cluster (subset) of triangles for culling (frustum/backface/occlusion).
requirements: vertex_positions must have float3 in the first 12 bytes; stride given
index_count/3 must be <= 512 (implementation limit)
vertex_count refers to the full mesh vertex count, not just the cluster

functions.name: meshopt_computeMeshletBounds
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API struct meshopt_Bounds meshopt_computeMeshletBounds(const unsigned int* meshlet_vertices, const unsigned char* meshlet_triangles, size_t triangle_count, const float* vertex_positions, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_positions_stride);
functions.description: Computes bounds (sphere and normal cone) for a meshlet given its vertex indirection and micro-triangle data.
requirements: vertex_positions must have float3 in the first 12 bytes; stride given
triangle_count must be <= 512 (implementation limit)
vertex_count refers to the full mesh vertex count

functions.name: meshopt_computeSphereBounds
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API struct meshopt_Bounds meshopt_computeSphereBounds(const float* positions, size_t count, size_t positions_stride, const float* radii, size_t radii_stride);
functions.description: Computes a bounding sphere around points or a set of spheres; returns center and radius with other fields zeroed.
requirements: positions must have float3 in the first 12 bytes of each element; positions_stride given
radii may be NULL; if not NULL, must have a non-negative float radius in the first 4 bytes; radii_stride given

functions.name: meshopt_partitionClusters
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API size_t meshopt_partitionClusters(unsigned int* destination, const unsigned int* cluster_indices, size_t total_index_count, const unsigned int* cluster_index_counts, size_t cluster_count, const float* vertex_positions, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_positions_stride, size_t target_partition_size);
functions.description: Partitions clusters into groups of similar size, favoring shared-vertex or spatial adjacency; returns the number of partitions and writes per-cluster partition ids.
requirements: destination must have space for cluster_count elements
destination[i] receives partition id
cluster_indices must list indices of each cluster sequentially
cluster_index_counts must provide count per cluster; the sum must equal total_index_count
vertex_positions may be NULL; if provided, must have float3 in first 12 bytes; stride given
target_partition_size is in clusters; resulting sizes may vary up to target + target/3

functions.name: meshopt_spatialSortRemap
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API void meshopt_spatialSortRemap(unsigned int* destination, const float* vertex_positions, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_positions_stride);
functions.description: Generates a remap to reorder points (vertices) for spatial locality; use with meshopt_remapVertexBuffer.
requirements: destination must have space for vertex_count elements
vertex_positions must have float3 in the first 12 bytes; stride given

functions.name: meshopt_spatialSortTriangles
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API void meshopt_spatialSortTriangles(unsigned int* destination, const unsigned int* indices, size_t index_count, const float* vertex_positions, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_positions_stride);
functions.description: Reorders triangles to improve spatial locality and writes a new index buffer. Can be combined with other optimizers.
requirements: destination must have space for index_count elements
vertex_positions must have float3 in the first 12 bytes; stride given

functions.name: meshopt_spatialClusterPoints
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API void meshopt_spatialClusterPoints(unsigned int* destination, const float* vertex_positions, size_t vertex_count, size_t vertex_positions_stride, size_t cluster_size);
functions.description: Reorders points into clusters to ensure good positional locality when splitting output into fixed-size chunks. Writes a new index order (length vertex_count).
requirements: destination must have space for vertex_count elements
vertex_positions must have float3 in the first 12 bytes; stride given
cluster_size specifies target cluster chunk size; only the last chunk may be smaller

functions.name: meshopt_quantizeHalf
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API unsigned short meshopt_quantizeHalf(float v);
functions.description: Quantizes a 32-bit float to IEEE-754 half-precision (fp16), rounding to nearest, clamping denormals to zero, preserving NaN, producing ±inf on overflow.
requirements: Input v is any float; representable magnitude range ~[6e-5, 65504]; denormals are flushed to 0

functions.name: meshopt_quantizeFloat
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API float meshopt_quantizeFloat(float v, int N);
functions.description: Quantizes a float to N mantissa bits while keeping IEEE-754 fp32 representation (preserves sign/exponent), rounding to nearest; preserves Inf/NaN, flushes denormals to zero.
requirements: N must be in [1,23] (assumed valid by function)

functions.name: meshopt_dequantizeHalf
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API float meshopt_dequantizeHalf(unsigned short h);
functions.description: Converts an IEEE-754 half-precision value back to 32-bit float; preserves Inf/NaN and flushes denormals to zero.
requirements: Input h is any 16-bit half-precision bit pattern

functions.name: meshopt_setAllocator
functions.signature: MESHOPTIMIZER_API void meshopt_setAllocator(void* (MESHOPTIMIZER_ALLOC_CALLCONV* allocate)(size_t), void (MESHOPTIMIZER_ALLOC_CALLCONV* deallocate)(void*));
functions.description: Sets custom allocation callbacks for all temporary allocations within the library; allocations are used temporarily and are deallocated in LIFO order.
requirements: allocate must return a valid pointer for requested size or handle out-of-memory per platform convention
deallocate must free pointers returned by allocate
Callbacks must be usable in a stack-like (LIFO) allocation pattern

functions.name: meshopt_quantizeUnorm
functions.signature: inline int meshopt_quantizeUnorm(float v, int N);
functions.description: C++ inline: Quantizes a float in [0,1] to an N-bit fixed-point unorm value using nearest rounding. Max reconstruction error 1/2^(N+1).
requirements: Input v is clamped to [0,1]
N must be a positive bit count (implicit); result range is [0, 2^N-1]

functions.name: meshopt_quantizeSnorm
functions.signature: inline int meshopt_quantizeSnorm(float v, int N);
functions.description: C++ inline: Quantizes a float in [-1,1] to an N-bit fixed-point snorm value using nearest rounding with sign-aware bias. Max reconstruction error 1/2^N.
requirements: Input v is clamped to [-1,1]
N must be >= 1 (implicit); result range is [-(2^(N-1)-1), 2^(N-1)-1]
